name: MEDIQA-QA
intro: MEDIQA-QA是ACL BioNLP Workshop发布的医疗问答推理基准，旨在推动自然语言推理和问题蕴涵识别在医疗问答领域的应用，要求参与者对提供的答案进行正确性判断和重新排序。
task_type: 答案验证, 答案排序
eval_feature: 医疗问答推理，自然语言推理和问题蕴涵识别
eval_feature_en: Medical QA reasoning, natural language inference and question entailment recognition
intro_en: MEDIQA-QA is a medical question answering reasoning benchmark released by the ACL BioNLP Workshop. It aims to advance the application of natural language inference and question entailment recognition in the medical QA domain, requiring participants to assess the correctness of provided answers and reorder them accordingly.

flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect consumer health questions for the MEDIQA medical QA shared task"] --> B["Submit questions to the CHiQA medical QA system to retrieve candidate answers"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MEDIQA 2019 shared task overview (ACL Anthology W19-5039). The paper defines MEDIQA over NLI, RQE, and QA tasks. For QA, medical consumer health questions are submitted to the CHiQA system to retrieve candidate answers; validation and test sets contain manually judged candidate answers (25 questions / 234 answers for validation and 150 questions / 1,107 answers for test); systems are encouraged to reuse RQE over MedQuAD and NLI relations to validate, filter, and rerank answers; official evaluation uses answer-ranking accuracy.
